opening.argument: The video walks viewers through building a coupon-and-deal website, beginning with the domain, hosting, WordPress and plugins it requires. It then shows a free theme and explains how to generate an affiliate link for a store page. The speaker also discusses creating a related Android application and cites his own affiliate earnings. The Rs 3000 starting-site call to action appears within that instructional context, not alongside a supported promise of guaranteed returns. The supplied record does not establish the offer's fulfillment or terms, but it also does not demonstrate a deceptive transaction.
